senses.gloss:
वेवी {c2c} A. (वेवीते)
1 To go.
--2
To obtain.
--3 To conceive^1, be
pregnant.
--4 To pervade.
--5 To cast,
throw.
--6 To eat.
--7 To wish,
desire.
--8 To shine; (seldom used
in classical literature).
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar and Jim Funderburk on 20210104. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/20.
